title: SF92 (2023-2024 Regular): Age eligibility to apply for a permit to carry a pistol at 18 years of age establishment

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-06; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/92/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced 2023-01-06. The bill strikes the age '21' and puts '18'. The quote joins the lead-in of paragraph (b) with clause (2) as the clause now reads.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2), paragraph (b): Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception set forth in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a permit to an applicant if the person: (2) is at least 18 years old and a citizen or a permanent resident of the United States;
